verdict.rationale: Bevy is a free, open-source Rust game-engine library added as a normal cargo dependency. It has no hosted service that ingests user data, so an AI-training opt-out control is a category error for this product type. The evidence pack contains nothing showing Bevy collects or processes user data in a way that would make a training opt-out applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
